name: sensor_modal_evidence
description: Call when a tactile change may be transient, using 1–4 frames from one episode; replaces repeated raw marker/depth comparisons for this question. Defaults: marker_change_px=1, depth_change_mm=0.05. Returns latest change, hand displacement, and any bilateral reversal on shared markers with little native-depth change, even when the latest interval is quiet. Frame indices map to recorded steps; null means unknown. Requires advancing physics and continuous references. One frame cannot establish change. Thresholds are descriptive; tracking accuracy, force, slip and contact absence remain unknown. No need to call on every observation.

marker_change_px.description: Minimum coherent marker excursion in pixels per compared interval.

depth_change_mm.description: Native tactile camera-depth difference threshold in mm; support requires over 1% of jointly valid pixels.
